metadata.title: Account | Slashie
metadata.description: Your Slashie email, phone, sign-in and notifications.

en.title: Account
en.descriptionBefore: Email, phone and sign-in. How others see you is in
en.contactDescription: How Slashie reaches you. Verifying shows they're yours; it isn't an ID or safety check.
en.signInDescription: The ways you can sign in to Slashie.

methods.passwordOn: Sign in with {email} and your password.
methods.linkBody: Choose the {provider} account you want to sign in with. Your Slashie email stays {email}.
methods.linkDone: {provider} is linked. You can sign in with it now.
methods.unlinkBody: You won't be able to sign in with {provider} any more. Your Slashie email stays the same, and you can link it again later.
methods.failed: Couldn't update how you sign in. Try again.

errors.LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password or keep your other sign-in before unlinking it.
errors.OAUTH_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: That {provider} account is already on another Slashie account, or this account already has a different {provider} account linked.
errors.INVALID_OAUTH_TOKEN: We couldn't confirm that {provider} sign-in. Try again.
errors.LOGIN_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED: That sign-in method can't be changed here.
errors.APPLE_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Apple didn't share an email address. Try again and choose to share your email.

password.setIntro: Add a password so you can also sign in with {email}.
password.saved: Password set. You can now sign in with your email too.
password.reauthBody: For your security, sign in again first. Then save your password within 10 minutes.
password.reauthDone: Thanks, you signed in again. You can save your password now.
password.failed: Couldn't save your password. Try again.

validation.passwordUnchanged: Choose a new password, not your current one.

errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: That's your current password. Choose a new one.
errors.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account has no password yet. Refresh the page to set one.
errors.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: This account already has a password. Refresh the page to change it.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, sign in again, then save your password within 10 minutes.
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.

en.notificationsDescription: What Slashie sends you, and the language you see.
en.webPushDescription: Get a notification when a quote, job update, or review request arrives and this tab is in the background.
en.webPushUnavailable: Browser notifications are not available until the server is configured.
en.webPushUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
en.webPushDenied: Notifications stay off until you allow them in the browser.
en.deleteDescription: Close your Slashie account. You have 30 days to change your mind.
deletePoints: Your account is switched off straight away: your profile, open tasks and quotes are hidden.
Open tasks are cancelled and pending quotes withdrawn. They stay that way even if you come back.
Sign in within 30 days and choose Restore to keep your account.
After 30 days your details are removed for good. People you worked with still see past bookings and reviews, shown as "Deleted user".
en.deletePasswordHelp: Enter your password to confirm it's you.
en.deleteReauthBody: For your security, sign in again first. Then confirm here within 10 minutes.
en.deleteReauthDone: Thanks, you signed in again. You can confirm now.
en.deleteLiveOrders: You have an active booking. Finish or cancel it before deleting your account.
en.deleteBlockedBody: You can delete your account once these bookings are done or cancelled:
en.deleteReauthExpired: That sign-in was more than 10 minutes ago. Sign in again to continue.
en.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
en.deleteScheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to restore it.
en.deleteScheduledNoDate: Your account will be deleted in 30 days. Sign in before then to restore it.

zh_hk.title: 帳戶
zh_hk.descriptionBefore: 電郵、電話和登入方式。其他人看到的資料在
zh_hk.contactDescription: Slashie 聯絡你的方式。驗證只證明它們屬於你，並非身份或安全審查。
zh_hk.signInDescription: 你可以用來登入 Slashie 的方式。

methods.linkBody: 請選擇你想用來登入的 {provider} 帳戶。你的 Slashie 電郵會維持為 {email}。
methods.linkDone: 已連結 {provider}，你現在可以用它登入。
methods.unlinkBody: 你將無法再用 {provider} 登入。你的 Slashie 電郵不會改變，你之後亦可以再次連結。
methods.failed: 未能更新登入方式，請再試一次。

errors.LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: 這是你唯一的登入方式。請先設定密碼，或保留另一個登入方式，然後再解除連結。
errors.OAUTH_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: 該 {provider} 帳戶已連結到另一個 Slashie 帳戶，或此帳戶已連結了另一個 {provider} 帳戶。
errors.INVALID_OAUTH_TOKEN: 未能確認該 {provider} 登入，請再試一次。
errors.LOGIN_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED: 無法在這裡更改該登入方式。
errors.APPLE_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Apple 沒有提供電郵地址。請再試一次，並選擇分享你的電郵。

password.setIntro: 加入密碼後，你亦可以用 {email} 登入。
password.saved: 密碼已設定，你現在亦可以用電郵登入。
password.reauthBody: 為了你的帳戶安全，請先重新登入，然後在 10 分鐘內儲存密碼。
password.reauthDone: 多謝，你已重新登入，現在可以儲存密碼。
password.failed: 未能儲存密碼，請再試一次。

validation.passwordTooShort: 請輸入最少 8 個字元。
validation.passwordsDontMatch: 兩次輸入的密碼不一致。
validation.passwordUnchanged: 請選擇新密碼，不要沿用目前的密碼。

errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: 請輸入最少 8 個字元。
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: 這是你目前的密碼，請選擇新密碼。
errors.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: 此帳戶尚未設定密碼。請重新載入頁面再設定。
errors.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: 此帳戶已有密碼。請重新載入頁面再更改。
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: 為了你的帳戶安全，請重新登入，然後在 10 分鐘內儲存密碼。
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。
errors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。

zh_hk.notificationsDescription: Slashie 傳送給你的內容，以及你看到的語言。
zh_hk.marketingEmailsDescription: 偶爾傳送的消息和使用貼士。
zh_hk.webPushDescription: 當報價、工作更新或評價邀請到達，而此分頁在背景時，接收通知。
zh_hk.webPushUnavailable: 伺服器尚未設定，暫時未能使用瀏覽器通知。
zh_hk.webPushDenied: 請先在瀏覽器允許通知。
zh_hk.deleteDescription: 關閉你的 Slashie 帳戶。你有 30 天時間改變主意。
zh_hk.deleteIntro: 刪除後會發生以下事情：
deletePoints: 帳戶會立即停用：你的個人檔案、開放中的任務和報價會被隱藏。
開放中的任務會被取消，待處理的報價會被撤回。即使你之後還原帳戶，它們也會維持這樣。
在 30 天內登入並選擇「還原」，即可保留帳戶。
30 天後你的資料會被永久移除。與你合作過的人仍會看到過往的預約和評價，顯示為「已刪除的用戶」。
zh_hk.deletePasswordHelp: 輸入密碼以確認是你本人。
zh_hk.deleteReauthBody: 為了你的帳戶安全，請先重新登入，然後在 10 分鐘內回來確認。
zh_hk.deleteReauthDone: 多謝，你已重新登入，現在可以確認。
zh_hk.deleteLiveOrders: 你有進行中的預約。請先完成或取消，然後再刪除帳戶。
zh_hk.deleteBlockedTitle: 請先完成進行中的預約
zh_hk.deleteBlockedBody: 以下預約完成或取消後，你便可以刪除帳戶：
zh_hk.deleteReauthExpired: 你重新登入已超過 10 分鐘，請再登入一次以繼續。
zh_hk.deleteFailed: 未能刪除帳戶，請再試一次。
zh_hk.deleteScheduled: 你的帳戶將於 {date} 刪除。在此之前登入即可還原。
zh_hk.deleteScheduledNoDate: 你的帳戶將於 30 天後刪除。在此之前登入即可還原。
